Na dhup, na haphton ka intzar! 10 minat men banaen chatapta Instant Amla Achar
Steam se kasailapan kam karne ki trick, dardara masala aur nimbu ke secret ke saath tikha chatpata amla achar.
Instant Amla Achar bina dhoop mein sukhaye, kadhai mein pakakar
Amla ko 15-20 minute steam dene ki trick
Saunf, dhaniya, methi dana ka dardara masala
Nimbu ka ras aur glass jar mein achar rakhne ka tarika
Comment karein: agle video mein amla ki kaun si recipe chahiye?
